label: Add to (fluent)
description: Produce the sum a + N automatically, without visibly executing a strategy. The automatised counterpart of skill.add_to: mastery is judged by response time rather than correctness alone, since correctness alone conflates a child still running a strategy every time with one who just knows the fact.
source: Carpenter, Fennema, Franke, Levi & Empson, Children's Mathematics: Cognitively Guided Instruction (2nd ed., 2014)
